transactions.desc: The Dodgers recalled Hurt from Triple-A Oklahoma on Sunday.
The Astros recalled Ullola from Triple-A Sugar Land on Sunday.
The Astros optioned Blanco to Triple-A Sugar Land on Sunday.
Atlanta granted Santana's release from his minor-league contract Sunday, Jeff Passan of ESPN.com reports.
The Athletics claimed Rock off waivers from the White Sox on Sunday and optioned him to Triple-A Las Vegas.
The Cubs optioned Assad to Triple-A Iowa on Sunday, Jesse Rogers of ESPN.com reports.
The Cubs reinstated Cabrera (hamstring) from the 15-day injured list ahead of his scheduled start Sunday versus the Cardinals at Wrigley Field, Jesse Rogers of ESPN.com reports.
The Athletics recalled Hernaiz from Triple-A Las Vegas on Sunday. He'll start at third base and bat ninth in the Athletics' series finale versus the Rangers.
The Pirates optioned Dotel to Triple-A Indianapolis on Sunday.
The Pirates optioned Brannigan to Triple-A Indianapolis on Sunday.
The Pirates recalled Yorke from Triple-A Indianapolis on Sunday. He'll start at third base and bat seventh in the Pirates' series finale versus the Red Sox.
The Pirates recalled Barco from Triple-A Indianapolis on Sunday.
Toronto reinstated Little from the paternity list Sunday.
Toronto optioned Tiedemann to Triple-A Buffalo on Sunday.
The Red Sox recalled Gasper from Triple-A Worcester on Sunday.
Boston recalled Burgos from Triple-A Worcester on Sunday.
Arizona designated Abner for assignment Sunday.
Arizona selected Santana's contract from Triple-A Reno on Sunday.
The Tigers designated Cruz for assignment Sunday.
The Tigers selected Callahan's contract from Triple-A Toledo on Sunday. He'll start in left field and bat seventh in the series finale versus the White Sox.
Atlanta designated Young for assignment on Sunday.
Atlanta selected Kerr's contract from Triple-A Gwinnett on Sunday.
The Brewers acquired  Ornelas from the Athletics on Saturday in exchange for cash considerations.
The Rangers designated Gonzales for assignment Saturday.
The Rangers reinstated Junis (thigh) from the 15-day injured list Saturday.
The  Athletics traded INF Jonathan Ornelas to the Milwaukee Brewers.
The Angels optioned Peralta to Triple-A Salt Lake following Friday's game against the Royals.
The Angels selected Fulmer's contract from Triple-A Salt Lake on Saturday.
The Brewers designated Bae for assignment Saturday, Adam McCalvy of MLB.com reports.
The Mariners claimed Watson off waivers from Detroit on Saturday and optioned him to Triple-A Tacoma.
